title: Broggy! 🔥
description: The best mascot from Mario and Luigi serie in Minecraft! 🔥
body:
**///About Mod///**

This is an altered version of the original model made by YoshiMaker of Bully, which replaces him with Broggy

**[https://discord.gg/pQnwM4gu8M](https://discord.gg/pQnwM4gu8M)**

-Custom texture pack (x32)

-Models made in Blockbench

-Download the required packs for non missing textures

-Inspiration straight from Mario and Luigi Bowser Inside Story

-You need the **[https://drive.google.com/file/d/1oaDpNnZEKII5r7ZqTUlX1KuYsmI0jVkG/view](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1oaDpNnZEKII5r7ZqTUlX1KuYsmI0jVkG/view)**

-Also **[https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib/version/ApKEGN4z](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib/version/ApKEGN4z)**

-And also **[https://modrinth.com/mod/playeranimator/version/1.0.2+1.19.4-forge](https://modrinth.com/mod/playeranimator/version/1.0.2+1.19.4-forge)**
